titulo: Reading: the biography of Roald Dahl

linhas.txt: Hello, hello! Reading time! Let's read about Roald Dahl.
Roald Dahl was born on the thirteenth of September, nineteen sixteen, in Wales.
His parents were from Norway. His mother was a great storyteller.
At school, the boys were sometimes chocolate testers for a famous chocolate company.
Olha que legal: essa experiência inspirou o livro Charlie and the Chocolate Factory!
Later, he worked in Africa, and then he enlisted in the Royal Air Force during the Second World War.
Ele foi piloto. In nineteen forty, he crashed his plane in the desert.
Then he went to the usa and started writing.
He married Patricia Neal, and they had five children.
He told stories to his children at bedtime. Na hora de dormir!
As crianças gostavam tanto que ele resolveu escrever as histórias.
James and the Giant Peach was his first published children's book.
Matilda was published in nineteen eighty-eight.
Agora repara: o texto usa he, que é third person. Usa past tense: was born, worked, married. E segue a chronological order.
So... it is a biography! Good job!
